parts.label: Cuticle
parts.note: A waxy, see-through coat that stops water loss

parts.label: Upper epidermis
parts.note: A clear skin that lets light through

parts.label: Palisade cells
parts.note: Packed with chloroplasts: most food is made here

parts.label: Spongy layer
parts.note: Loose cells with air spaces for gases

parts.label: Vein
parts.note: Xylem brings water; phloem carries food away

parts.label: Stoma
parts.note: A tiny pore: CO2 in, oxygen and water out

parts.label: Lower epidermis
parts.note: The underside skin, dotted with stomata
